problemSignature.symptom: The web app could read one sample manifest, but it did not have a typed contract for multi-project BoardForge dashboard data generated by the local engine.

rootCause: BoardForge's engine/report side produced validation evidence, while the web side only modeled a single raw manifest. That left the dashboard dependent on ad hoc data shaping instead of a stable product API.
fixSummary: Add web TypeScript types and helper labels for BoardForge dashboard data, plus a generated sample dashboard JSON built from REV_F and the odd-shape manufacturing fixture.

testsAdded: dashboard sample manifest is product-readable and clean

conditions: Use BoardForge project-dashboard-data as the web app source of truth
Use normalized dashboard cards instead of raw DRC/ERC parser outputs
Keep sample dashboard data generated from real validated fixture manifests

recipe: Generate dashboard JSON from one or more boardforge-project-manifest.json files.
Expose the project-dashboard-data schema to the web app TypeScript layer.
Render dashboard status from readiness, manufacturing readiness, and blockers.
Keep raw project manifests available as evidence links, not as the UI's only contract.
safetyRules: Do not mark a dashboard project ready unless the normalized card is ready and has no blockers.
Do not detach dashboard sample data from real fixture/manufacturing evidence.
Do not touch protected ESC/FC projects while generating sample dashboard data.
